mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior three months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which drives higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and based on the current trend of HOUST.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST increased by at least 0.5% over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior three months signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the early pandemic crisis regime, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals aggressive monetary policy that stabilizes equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the early pandemic crisis when FEDFUNDS declined, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior three months indicates rising inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL increased by at least 0.2% over the prior three months, or the Rank IC is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior three months signals robust economic activity across both consumer and manufacturing sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO increased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown regime (indicated by declining industrial production), a further decline in INDPRO signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during a manufacturing slowdown when INDPRO declined, or the Rank IC is above -0.03.
